packageRules.description: boto3 and botocore release together, and an exact pin of one needs the matching other, so update them in one PR instead of two that must be merged in order (INFRA-614).

The @letsmod/dcl-* packages are released together from the dcl-kit monorepo with one shared version, so update them in one PR per repository instead of one per package. Bump the package.json range on every release, even one the current range already allows, so the manifest states the minimum dcl-kit version a repository needs (INFRA-808).

Offer Python patch updates on their own branch, so holding a new minor version for approval (next rule) doesn't hold back patch releases. Must not match on update type: Renovate decides the split before the update type is known.

A new Python minor version often lands before the libraries and tools a repository depends on support it, so hold it on the Dependency Dashboard until someone approves it there. Patch updates are not affected.
